description: Unit test code for the Driver class in the webkitpy layout tests port module, testing command wrapping, URI conversions, block reading, crash detection, and process management.

classes.name: DriverTest
classes.description: Test suite for the Driver class, covering command wrapping, URI conversion, block reading, crash detection, and process cleanup.

methods.name: make_port
methods.description: Creates a mock Port instance with 'Release' configuration.

methods.name: _assert_wrapper
methods.description: Asserts that the command wrapper produces the expected output.

methods.name: test_command_wrapper
methods.description: Tests the command wrapper with various inputs, including spaces and null input.

methods.name: test_test_to_uri
methods.description: Verifies conversion from test paths to URIs.

methods.name: test_uri_to_test
methods.description: Verifies conversion from URIs back to test paths.

methods.name: test_read_block
methods.description: Tests reading a non-binary content block.

methods.name: test_read_binary_block
methods.description: Tests reading a binary content block.

methods.name: test_read_base64_block
methods.description: Tests reading a base64-encoded content block.

methods.name: test_no_timeout
methods.description: Verifies command line includes '--no-timeout' when specified.

methods.name: test_check_for_driver_crash
methods.description: Tests crash detection logic with various error lines and process states.

methods.name: test_creating_a_port_does_not_write_to_the_filesystem
methods.description: Ensures port creation does not modify the filesystem.

methods.name: test_stop_cleans_up_properly
methods.description: Checks that stopping the driver cleans up temporary directories.

methods.name: test_two_starts_cleans_up_properly
methods.description: Verifies cleanup when starting the driver twice.

methods.name: test_start_actually_starts
methods.description: Confirms that the driver starts the server process.
